dialect: TM Forum TMF641 (REST/JSON service ordering, intra-operator)
note: Lifted semantic model, TM Forum TMF641 (service ordering) side. Same REST/OpenAPI family conventions as the Sonata side (orderItem, action, state, characteristic) because MEF LSO built on the TMF Open API framework — so the two look structurally alike on the surface while denoting different things. TMF641 is the operator's INTERNAL service order: it activates the technical SERVICE that realises a product, distinct from the commercial product ordered across the carrier seam.

concepts.label: serviceOrder
concepts.gloss: the operator's internal order to provision and activate services in its own network; the order envelope raised to fulfil a product ordered across the seam
concepts.example: SO-88 raised to fulfil product order PO-88

concepts.label: orderItem
concepts.gloss: one line of the service order carrying an action (add/modify/delete) on a single technical service

concepts.label: service
concepts.gloss: the technical service the operator provisions and activates in its network to deliver a product; the intra-operator TECHNICAL realisation, distinct from the commercial product that was ordered
concepts.example: an L2 EVPL service, serviceType=EVPL, activated between two termination points

concepts.label: serviceCharacteristic
concepts.gloss: the service's technical characteristics as name/value pairs — bandwidth, class of service, VLAN; the operator's realised technical parameters for the service

concepts.label: place
concepts.gloss: the geographic place the service is delivered — the service termination / demarcation point
concepts.example: service termination at 350 E St, New York

concepts.label: state
concepts.gloss: the lifecycle state of the SERVICE order/item in the operator's TECHNICAL process; tracks technical activation in the network, not commercial fulfilment to a buyer
concepts.example: state=inProgress (enum: acknowledged, rejected, pending, held, inProgress, completed, failed, cancelled)

concepts.label: serviceSpecification
concepts.gloss: the service specification — the technical blueprint/template the service is instantiated from; an intra-operator design artefact with no counterpart in the commercial product order

concepts.label: supportingService
concepts.gloss: the supporting lower-layer service this service is built on (e.g. the transport underlay); an internal technical dependency not exposed in the product order
